verse_1.lyrics: The little chicks say, "Cheap, cheap, cheap" when they are chilly, when they sleep. Mother hen looks all day for wheat and corn. She gives them food and keeps them warm. Under her two wings, they will go to sleep until tomorrow without a peep.
